description: This PHP source file defines the InstallerPasswordStrengthService class, which extends PasswordStrengthService to implement password policy checks for the OrangeHRM system during installation. It includes methods for validating password length, character requirements, and spaces, utilizing a TextHelperService for auxiliary text operations.

classes.name: InstallerPasswordStrengthService
classes.description: A service class extending PasswordStrengthService to enforce password policies during system installation, including minimum length, character type requirements, and space restrictions.

methods.name: getTextHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of TextHelperService used for text processing.

methods.name: getMinLength
methods.description: Returns the minimum password length, defaulting to 8 if not set.

methods.name: getMaxLength
methods.description: Returns the maximum password length, defaulting to 64 if not set.

methods.name: getMinNoOfLowercaseLetters
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of lowercase letters required, defaulting to 1.

methods.name: getMinNoOfUppercaseLetters
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of uppercase letters required, defaulting to 1.

methods.name: getMinNoOfNumbers
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of numerical digits required, defaulting to 1.

methods.name: getMinNoOfSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of special characters required, defaulting to 1.

methods.name: getIsSpacesAllowed
methods.description: Returns whether spaces are allowed in passwords, defaulting to 'false'.

methods.name: checkPasswordPolicies
methods.description: Validates the provided password against multiple policies and returns corresponding messages for any violations.
